en_US: Wow, you’re energetic and hardworking!
I won’t get tricked by your cuteness!
Don’t eat the grass along the road of
life! My personal slogan!
Together with these three Pokémon I’ll
get stronger! I’ll get bigger!
Do you think you can keep up with me?
They call me the “Victorious Victor”!
Jump! Fight! Be like the wind!
Someday I want to fly high!
Behind that cute face lies hidden
power! You’ll see it with your own eyes!
This is our team!
This is our power!
Power is strength! Strength is power!
I’ll use that power to climb to the top!
Do you know me!? Do you know what kind
of hidden talents I have?!
A Pokémon’s strength and power...
I’ll show them to you!
Pokémon’s friendship and affection! If
you’ve got that, you’ll never lose!
My Pokémon are always protecting me!
So there’s no way that we’ll lose!
The accuracy of Bug-type Pokémon!
I’m a man who knows all about them!
That skill is like a well-oiled machine!
The result of the calculation is...!
Do you know the skill of
these Pokémon?!
Never crumble, no matter what happens!
That’s the kind of friendship we’ve got!
That kind of tenacity is common in
everyone! That spirit! That gutsiness!
On the mountain five years together...
The friendship is everlasting!
Master fighting! Live for fighting!
And live for the Pokéathlon!
I can see victory! That’s because I
don’t think there’s any way I’ll lose!
I can fly with these Pokémon so far!
Over the rainbow!
Jump to victory!
Jump to the other side of victory!
Why can you jump that high?!
Simple, it’s because it’s all you can do.
We’re not done. We’re just beginning!
We’ll show you just how far we can jump!
Flying is like breathing to me!
That’s only natural, if you ask me.
It’s impossible to measure that speed!
A legendary team known for speed!
Finally here! The amazingly persistent
Gym Leader! How much true power?
Cuteness, strength, and speed!
A girl with sparkle!
Nothing in front of this guy... Even a
bolt of lightning can come from behind!
Run! The thing beyond that--the goal
is called friendship!
The famous guy on the TV all the time
is now participating in the Pokéathlon!
All right! The cute and energetic Gym
Leader from the Sinnoh region!
Power... That is cuteness!
Could you possibly believe that power?
Abandon common sense!
This is reality!
Power is everything! Power is right!
Power is proof of friendship!
I’ve got innate talent! This genius is
going to seize victory!
Friendship? We don’t need it. That’s
because we are already one.
My Pokémon are always protecting me,
so there’s no way we can lose!
Such splendid dancing and splendid
winning! I’ve come from Ecruteak City!
Are we looking at an illusion? The most
skilled Pokéathlete!
Gym Leader of steel is participating!
I’ll show you steely determination!
I’m so full of energy! What’s fatigue?
Where’s this stamina coming from?!
Chance of victory: 100%! No doubt!
I just came up with that calculation!
Morning is practice, noon is practice,
and evening...is training!
He said it...
Fatigue is not in our vocabulary!
The world we’re aiming for is the
championship, that world!
Flying... Even gravity is
keeping its distance from her!
The Gym Leader of flight appears!
My dad’s Pokémon really soar!
We can go as far as we want...
Come on, let’s go together!
There’s no sky above him!
There’s a sky below him!
